learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for drafting, signing, and developing projects in the field of industrial engineering whose object is, in accordance with the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of Order CIN/351/2009 of February 9, the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or exploitation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes.
Capacity for directing the activities object of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Capacity for handling specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Capacity to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Capacity to apply quality principles and methods.
Capacity for organization and planning in the business environment, and other institutions and organizations.
Capacity to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and capacity to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.

teaching_methods: Monitoring by the tutor from the collaborating entity

assessment_methods.method: Assessment by the tutor at the collaborating entity
Degree of achievement of the objectives of the internship training project
Content and quality of the final internship report and its presentation and defense

assessment_rules: The academic tutor will assign the grade based on meetings with the student, the final internship report (which includes the student's self-evaluation), and the assessment by the collaborating entity's tutor. The grading is weighted as follows: 50% for the collaborating entity's tutor assessment, 25% for the achievement of the training project objectives, and 25% for the content and quality of the final report and its presentation and defense. Academic fraud may result in a failing grade ('0') and disciplinary action.
